snippet.title: War: The Final Assault - Mame 0.196 - Shortplay
snippet.description:
A new 3D game added to Mame 0.196 thanks to the efforts of Mamedev and Ted Green that was working to make this game playable.

Make sure you adjust the controls of this game properly on Mame because there are not the standard. You must use one stick to move and the other to move the crosshair (with controllers is the same as it was an FPS)

Sometimes the game slow down on FPS (but i think is because there are a lot of polygons on screen and my CPU is not capable to mantain the same framerate but i don't know if the original game has framerate issues or not because i never see it on arcades).

Fun to play but it still have some glitches (if you play on 1st person Mame will crash)

Only for testing purposes

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Un nuevo juego con gráficos 3D añadido a Mame 0.196 gracias a los esfuerzos de los chicos de Mamedev y de Ted Green que ha estado trabajando duro para hacerlo semi-jugable en este revisión

En este juego hay que ajustar bien los controles porque difieren un poco de lo que es habitual, de hecho si tenéis un gamepad deberéis de configurarlo como si estuvieseis jugando a un FPS

Divertido de jugar, pero tened en cuenta que si ponéis el juego en modo primera persona, mame crasheara al poco tiempo de estar jugando.

Video subido solo por motivos de testeo del emulador
